text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Fwooooh! I can't help but get hyped up! 
Fan Appreciation Day has finally arrived!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
That means—! A day where Umamusume-chans 
give a forbidden reverse-appreciation to a 
fan like me~. M-My sanity is slip-ping~...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Whaaat, I'm super busy today...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huh, Trainer?
choice_data_list:
I'm on the giving side of fan service 
today, after all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek, I didn't hear anything about this~? 
Today I was supposed to forget about the 
Twinkle Series and just be a pure-hearted 
fan...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Who would even benefit from fan service 
from me~?!

I dragged the complaining Agnes Digital to 
the autograph session venue.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, there's quite a line for me too... 
W-W-What kind of weirdos are these 
people?)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Did you mistake me for someone else's 
line? Even if you try to squeeze it out of 
me, I don't have Creek-san's motherly 
warmth...)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Huh, is the frontrunner coming this 
way!?)

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Agudigi-san, I'm a huge fan!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: ...What is your aim?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: U-Uh, n-no, thank you very much...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I don't really have any new releases, but 
I'd love to chat about the Umamusume~

And so, by interacting with the fans, 
Agnes Digital gradually got used to it, 
and...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Alright, alright, I properly wrote your 
name on the autograph board, too.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And as a bonus, I'll throw in a 'Turf & 
Dirt Bottle.' It's not for sale, so think 
of it as a souvenir for today...

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, thank you! I'm so glad I came~. I 
love you guys even more now!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
E-Even though I'm such an awkward idol to 
support, if you could still watch over 
me...
choice_data_list:
You've got the fans' hearts firmly in your 
grasp, huh.

You've got the fans' hearts firmly in your 
grasp, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes. I'm usually on the other side of 
the line, you see. That's precisely why—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I can see it! The feelings of those who 
support her! Even more than the feelings 
of the one being supported!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...So, you see, if you put yourself in 
their shoes, the answer naturally presents 
itself.

Agnes Digital seems to know exactly what 
it takes to make her fans happy.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's keep this momentum going! We 
don't want any girls ending up 
disappointed because they ran out of time 
before closing.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: "Cold reception" isn't in my dictionary!

And so, Agnes Digital worked diligently 
all day long for the sake of the fans.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh, looking at it that way, this event 
still has plenty of room for improvement.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
With just a little creativity, it should 
be easier to support others, and easier to 
be supported as well.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Nyufufu, Trainer... Once this autograph 
session is over, can I just go wild on 
this whole venue?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
If I can just get permission, I'd be happy 
to show you Digi-tan's event-organizer 
spirit, though?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Aha, spoken like someone who truly gets 
Umamusume fans! Leave it to me, then!

And so, once the autograph session ended, 
Agnes Digital started running the event.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Umm... let's set up a fan participation 
slot for this game. There's no risk of 
running into them and causing injuries.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Once this ball game is over, let's make 
time to take photos together. I'm sure 
plenty of people will want to use them as 
their wallpapers!"

And so, the Fan Appreciation Festival was 
rapidly upgraded, and—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Today turned out to be a splendid event. 
Though it seems someone behind the scenes 
played a pivotal role—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It's Agnes Digital. To think she complied 
with such strict guidelines while packing 
in a project of this scale...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Digital! Way to go! Thanks to you, 
the whole place is buzzing!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, the cafe and the food stalls are 
both a massive hit thanks to the cute 
extras~♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Digital-chan! Buono, buono♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
E-Eeeek...? That's far too much praise... 
I only did what I could...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
You're amazing! Even after tearing down 
all those barriers, not a single problem 
came up!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Today's hero is Digital-senpai!! Alright 
everyone, toss-her-in-the-air formation, 
go!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Huh, what's this?! All the horse girls at 
once...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho! Heave-ho!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Whaaat is this eveeent?! Are you a goood?!

On this day, Agnes Digital became an 
Umamusume supported and cheered on by all 
of Tracen Academy.
